content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NFDC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. content_sections.heading: NFDC Senior Executive Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: PG in Marketing/Media Management/Mass Communication/ Business Administration/Film/Media Studies/or related field.

content_sections.heading: NFDC Senior Executive Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NFDC Senior Executive - Marketing & Business Development Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NFDC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NFDC Senior Executive – Marketing & Business Development recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the NFDC Senior Executive – Marketing & Business Development post is 27-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by NFDC?
faq.answer: NFDC has released a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Senior Executive – Marketing & Business Development.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Marketing, Media Management, Mass Communication, Business Administration, Film, Media Studies, or a related field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Executive – Marketing & Business Development position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Executive – Marketing & Business Development role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 80,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the NFDC recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official NFDC website on or before the last date of application.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the NFDC Senior Executive post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Application Screening followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location is Mumbai, Maharashtra.
